notes: Fixes what Crisp told you about combed footage. The last update taught Crisp to straighten out old tape and DVD recordings — the fine horizontal stripes you see on anything moving — before it enhances anything. What Crisp said on screen had not caught up: it still told you it could not do that and sent you off to another app first, and asking for it in your own words got the same answer and did nothing at all. Crisp now says what it actually does, and it is also clearer about the three cases where you still have to do it yourself: the Max quality setting rebuilds the frames it is handed without straightening them first, so run an ordinary Enhance over that footage and take the result to Max; HDR recordings are left alone; and an edit exported from the timeline is not straightened either, because the clips are scaled to a common size while the edit is put together and the stripes stop being detectable by then, so enhance those clips before you build the edit.
